work: PRED-0012: Modulator-free multi-state Cryo-EM gating kinematics benchmark testing whether SE(3) x SE(3)-invariant apo-to-ATP conformational reorganization s_kin(i) = 1 - lDDT_sym(i; 5UAK, 6MSM) (Mariani et al. 2013 published defaults R_0 = 15.0 A and {0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0} A over shared Chain A C-alpha residues) predicts US FDA KALYDECO v36 Table 3 ivacaftor monotherapy responsiveness on the fixed 20-variant domain-disjoint held-out test split (NBD1, TMD2, NBD2_C_terminal).

claims.statement: Across modulator-free human CFTR Cryo-EM structures 5UAK (1,139 Chain A C-alpha residues, ATP-free dephosphorylated WT) and 6MSM (1,181 Chain A C-alpha residues, phosphorylated ATP/Mg-bound E1371Q), S_common contains 1,130 shared residues with exact SE(3) x SE(3) rigid-motion invariance and state-swap symmetry, reproducing cross-NBD ATP Site 1 (K464-H1348: 32.5927 -> 10.9161 A) and Site 2 (T582-G1246: 23.5583 -> 7.8865 A) dimer closure (> 15.0 A contraction) and separating cytosolic gating/catalytic controls {E267, S1347, H1348, E1371} (s_kin > 0.45) from corrector/beta-core scaffolding controls {W361, R450, R1102} (s_kin < 0.25).
claims.dataset: tools/cftr-model/data/5UAK.cif.gz (RCSB PDB 5UAK, CC0 1.0) + tools/cftr-model/data/6MSM.cif.gz (RCSB PDB 6MSM, CC0 1.0) + tools/cftr-model/data/p13569.json (UniProtKB P13569, CC BY 4.0)

methods.name: shlex mmCIF parser with 15.0 A 3D cubic spatial voxel grid
methods.difference: tokenizes _atom_site and _struct_ref_seq_dif via shlex, rejects UNK chains R/B, and indexes shared C-alpha atoms in SpatialGrid15A

methods.name: character-level mmCIF state-machine lexer with 50-digit Decimal matrices
methods.difference: zero shared imports; parses mmCIF character-by-character without shlex/re and verifies all 1,130 shared C-alpha residues in 50-digit Decimal

claims.statement: On the 11 placed missense variants of the fixed 20-variant held-out test split (NBD1, TMD2, NBD2_C_terminal; 5 KALYDECO-responsive and 6 non-responsive), modulator-free apo-to-ATP conformational reorganization s_kin(i) = 1 - lDDT_sym(i; 5UAK, 6MSM) achieves conditional ROC-AUC 0.966667 (29/30 pairs, resolving TM12 pore hinge D1152H at s_kin = 9/32 = 0.281250 above all 6 non-responsive variants and missing only A455E vs V520F), exceeding standalone AlphaMissense responsiveness s_AM(i) = 1 - AM(i) at 0.666667 (2/3 = 20/30 pairs).
claims.dataset: tools/cftr-model/data/5UAK.cif.gz + tools/cftr-model/data/6MSM.cif.gz + benchmarks/theratype/theratype_open_annotations_2026-11-21.json (openfda-label KALYDECO v36 Table 3 + myvariant dbnsfp.alphamissense)

methods.name: 15.0 A voxel-grid float64 lDDT_sym + pairwise Mann-Whitney loop
methods.difference: assembles N_sym(i) via SpatialGrid15A + math.dist and enumerates all 30 positive-negative missense pairs in float64

methods.name: 50-digit Decimal all-pairs distances + exact Fraction s_kin and Wilcoxon rank-sum
methods.difference: evaluates (dx^2+dy^2+dz^2).sqrt() in 50-digit Decimal, exact rational s_kin = Fraction(4|N_sym|-c, 4|N_sym|), and exact Wilcoxon rank-sum 29/30

claims.statement: Across all 20 held-out test variants (7 KALYDECO-responsive and 13 non-responsive across NBD1, TMD2, NBD2_C_terminal), class-gated modulator-free gating reorganization g_kin achieves abstention-aware ROC-AUC 0.835165 (76/91 pairs, held-out error 15/91 = 0.164835), exceeding both the deterministic sequence-consequence class baseline at 0.681319 (62/91 pairs) and identically gated g_AM at 0.736264 (67/91 pairs), supporting pre-registered PRED-0012.

methods.name: regex canonical-splice gate + float64 pairwise Mann-Whitney ROC-AUC
methods.difference: applies CANONICAL_SPLICE_RE + 0.50 + 0.50*s_kin and enumerates all 91 positive-negative pairs directly

methods.name: charwise HGVS splice gate + exact Fraction Wilcoxon mid-rank sum
methods.difference: parses canonical +/-1,2 splice sites character-by-character without regex and evaluates exact rational rank-sum 76/91

claims.statement: On the 10-variant Lasso_N_terminal / TMD1 / R_domain train split (7 missense: 4 KALYDECO-responsive P67L, R117H, G178R, L206W and 3 non-responsive G85E, R334W, R347P), s_kin yields conditional missense ROC-AUC 0.500000 (6/12 pairs, gated g_kin abstention-aware ROC-AUC 0.750000 = 18/24): although s_kin elevates ECL1 outer-pore R117H (0.613095) and ICL1 G178R (0.636029) above G85E (0.145833) and R347P (0.250000), residual-trafficking Lasso/TM3 alleles P67L (0.140625) and L206W (0.075581) sit in locally rigid transmembrane scaffolding while non-responsive TM6 outer-vestibule charge-loss mutant R334W undergoes large gating reorganization (0.511364) yet disrupts anion permeation rather than gating.

Mariani et al. (2013) defined the Local Distance Difference Test (lDDT) as a superposition-free local structural comparison score evaluating the fraction of inter-atomic distances within a 15.0 A inclusion radius preserved across four tolerance thresholds {0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0} A.

Liu et al. (2017) and Zhang, Liu & Chen (2018) determined the Cryo-EM structures of dephosphorylated ATP-free human CFTR (PDB 5UAK, 3.87 A) and phosphorylated ATP-bound E1371Q human CFTR (PDB 6MSM, 3.2 A), resolving NBD1:NBD2 head-to-tail dimerization and transmembrane helical gating transitions in the absence of small-molecule CFTR modulators.
claims.attributed_to: Liu, Zhang, Csanady, Gadsby & Chen (2017), Cell 169:85-95.e8; Zhang, Liu & Chen (2018), Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci. U.S.A. 115:12757-12762
